summary: Full backend (23 pytest tests) + frontend Playwright e2e testing of Familien-Kochbuch app. All backend APIs (ingredients, recipes CRUD, filters, ingredient match, cooked marking, sync, API-key middleware behavior) pass. Frontend flows verified: create recipe, search, filter by rating/calories, star rating, mark cooked, ingredient match, delete. UI/design matches Worn Recipe Journal aesthetic and is responsive on desktop viewport.

minor.issue: Recipes with empty ingredients[] always match any query (missing_count=0, match_percentage=100). Should probably exclude or flag recipes with no ingredients.

issues: Recipes with no ingredients still appear in match results without 'Fehlend' label or ingredients section; could confuse users

action_items: Consider filtering out recipes with empty ingredient lists from /api/recipes/match results, or marking match_percentage=0 in that case
Optional: Add validation to recipe form requiring at least one ingredient selection
critical_code_review_comments: API_KEY middleware correctly only protects /api/sync when API_KEY env is non-empty (verified by inspection; default empty in .env)
Mongo _id properly excluded everywhere via projection {_id: 0}
Pydantic Field(ge=0) validates non-negative nutritional values (negative payload returns 422)
App.js is ~580 lines - acceptable but consider splitting RecipeCard and RecipeForm into separate files for maintainability
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly; no hardcoded URLs
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes - good testability
seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_ prefixed data and clean up after themselves. UI test created and deleted UI_Test_Suppe recipe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 backend pytest tests pass (test_cookbook.py covers ingredients CRUD, recipes CRUD, search/filters, rating, ingredient match, cooked + sync). Playwright UI test covered full happy path. Minor logic edge case: recipes with no ingredients always match in /api/recipes/match - not blocking.
